title: Christmas Hotel
description: Erin works at the high-end Windsor Hotel in New York City hoping to soon be promoted to manager of the chain's upcoming hotel in Rome. But things take a turn when her boss puts her in charge of opening a brand-new Windsor Hotel in her hometown of Garland Grove, a small mountain town that that loves all things Christmas. The town isn't pleased with the new hotel. To make things more complicated, the man spearheading the movement against the new hotel is Connor, Erin's childhood friend.
